2023.TA1.2.s: The attached report presents the outcomes achieved on the objectives established in Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s 2022 Annual Plan. It includes results and insights regarding successes and challenges for the four focus areas - deep retrofits, net zero new construction, electrification of transportation and the electricity system - and for the functional teams that enable all aspects of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s work. Progress against Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s performance indicators - carbon emission reduction potential, mobilization of capital for low-carbon solutions, scaling potential, community benefits and equity - is presented quantitatively and qualitatively.

The Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships recommends that:

1. The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund receive this report for information.

2023.TA1.3.s: The 2023 Annual Plan is presented for Board consideration and approval. The plan is guided by Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Strategic Directions and Theory of Change, and benefits from analysis of the successes and challenges experienced in our past work. It sets out four priorities for the year which “follow the carbon”: accelerating deep retrofits, accelerating uptake of EVs, advancing net-zero ready new construction, and accelerating net-zero electricity. Longer-range objectives and specific annual targets are established for each of these, supported by activities from Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s functional teams. A multi-solving approach will be taken to all activities, recognizing that designing climate action to achieve social, financial and environmental objectives makes for more robust outcomes and helps prevent worsening inequities.
